name: Cherry Cola Tarantula | 1g
description:
Fizzy cherry sweetness with a spicy cola back-end. Hybrid balance means you get a head buzz that settles into the body over 20 minutes. Smells exactly like opening a can of cherry soda. One of our most unique profiles.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
